verdict.rationale: Poly documents in-app sharing of a file or folder with "anyone with a link", with revocable access. This is a minimal way to expose selected notes publicly without leaving the app, but nothing describes a published website or digital-garden experience. missing for 10: a publish-as-website or digital-garden feature, working inter-note links in the published output, site navigation or theming, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
